column1: # /usr/local/share/d32/setup/strings.tsv: the words of the Deep32 Workstation screens (First Start,
# Import Report, Pairing, the console lines). id TAB text; {name} is a value filled in when shown, {nl} a new
# line. Change the words here, never in the programs.

column2: Sign this Workstation in to your Tailscale account.
Open this address on any device where you can sign in to Tailscale (a phone will do):
This window moves on by itself once you have signed in.
Waiting for a network connection. Plug in a network cable, or check the network adapter of the virtual machine.
Waiting for Tailscale to give a sign-in address. This can take a minute.
Signed in. Approve this machine in your Tailscale admin console to finish.
The network link is switched off. Turn it on in a Terminal with: doas d32-link enable
Signed in. Waiting for the tailnet address.
This Workstation runs without a network link (loopback), so there is no Tailscale sign-in.
Signed in. This Workstation is on your tailnet as {name}.
In a virtual machine, add the disc 2 image as a second optical drive. The import starts by itself once the disc is found.
More than one disc 2 is attached. Leave one attached and remove the others.
Disc 2 is attached. The import starts in a moment.
Importing disc 2. Its signature and every file are checked before anything is installed.
Import Report shows each step and each pack as it goes.
Pair this Workstation with a {peer}: choose Pairing and type the code the {peer} shows.
You can close this window. Deep32 Status shows how search is doing.
The first-start status cannot be read from the desktop.
Switch to the console with Ctrl+Alt+F1 to read it there. Ctrl+Alt+F5 brings the desktop back.
The first start has not reported yet. This window updates by itself.

The first start sets this Workstation up after the install: the passwords, its own keys, the Tailscale sign-in, then disc 2 (content) and its import.{nl}{nl}This window shows where the first start stands and what to do next. It updates by itself every two seconds, and opens by itself when you log in until the first start is done.{nl}{nl}The sign-in address works only once and only for a few minutes. If it has expired, Tailscale gives a new one and this window shows it.{nl}{nl}The same lines are written on the console of this machine.

Copy disc 2 again from the release and attach the new copy.
Copy disc 2 again from the release and attach the new copy.
Clean the disc or copy the image again, then choose Try Again.
Use disc 2 only as the release publishes it. Do not import a disc whose signature fails.
Free some space on the system disk, or give the virtual machine a larger disk, then choose Try Again.
Use the disc 2 of the same release as this Workstation.
Choose Try Again. If it stops at the same place, keep this report for a bug report.
The previous content stays in use. Keep this report for a bug report.
Stopped during: {step}. Nothing is lost: Try Again carries on from there.
Imported. The new knowledge base and Library are in use.
Already in use: this disc 2 was imported before. Nothing was changed.
Stopped during: {step}. The previous knowledge base and Library are back in use.
Meaning search: waits for a Forge to be paired
Meaning search: off, the paired Forge serves another model
Attempt {attempt}, carrying on from an earlier import
The import report cannot be read. The import may still be starting; this window tries again every two seconds.
No import has run on this machine yet.
Deep32 Encyclopedia: reader edition of the corpus
Deep32 Encyclopedia: catalogue and word wheels
Carried on from an earlier import that stopped.
Meaning search starts once a Forge is paired. Keyword search works now.
The paired Forge serves another embedding model, so meaning search stays off. Keyword search works.
The previous knowledge base and Library are kept for going back ({bytes}).

Disc 2 holds the knowledge base and the Deep32 Encyclopedia. The import checks the signature of the disc and every file on it before it installs anything, then installs the new content beside the old and switches to it in one step.{nl}{nl}If the import stops, nothing you use has changed until the switch, and Try Again carries on where it stopped. Try Again asks for your password in a small Terminal.{nl}{nl}The report itself is kept in /var/db/d32/import.
Carrying on with the import of disc 2.
The import has finished. The report window shows the result.
The import stopped again. The report window shows where and why.
An import is already running. The report window shows its progress.
Pair with a Forge (type the code the Forge shows)
Pair with a relay (type the code the relay shows)
Let a headend pair with this Workstation (show a code)
Choose F, R, H, P or Q.
No {peer} was found on your tailnet. Its machine name must start with deep32- and it must be signed in to the same tailnet.
This Workstation runs on loopback: the {peer} on this same machine is used.
This Workstation is not signed in to Tailscale yet. Finish the sign-in first (First Start shows how).
The tailnet status could not be read. Try again in a minute.
Choose a {peer} (1 to {n}), or Q to go back:
Type the 10-character code the {peer} shows. Spaces and dashes are fine.
That is not a pairing code: {why} Type it again, or Q to go back.

codes use only the letters A to Z and the digits 2 to 7.
